layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.

The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Class: one small calm resource marker recognisable by its shape alone, smaller and less saturated than a unit, thick single-colour black outline, simple shapes. It sits directly on the empty transparent background with nothing drawn under it.

layers.text: Subject: a small chunky cute wild boar standing and looking to the lower right, with a big head, a short blunt snout with a dark grey nose, two tiny cream tusks, short stubby legs and a stiff dark crest of bristles along its back, soft ash-grey and dusky taupe fur with a pale cream snout; muted, calm colours; the boar is the only thing in the image.
The boar is small and compact, only about two thirds of the image wide and tall, with empty transparent space all around it. Its ear insides are dark grey.
